findings.evidence: Only STOMP CONNECT is authenticated; SUBSCRIBE frames are returned unchanged and no destination/session assignment policy is configured.
findings.impact: Client-side session filtering cannot prevent an authenticated subscriber from requesting another session topic.

findings.evidence: No containers are running and docker-compose.yml contains infrastructure services only.
findings.impact: The mandatory authenticated gateway/proctor connection and real event cannot be reproduced.

decision: End the optional phase without Flutter dependency, transport, BLoC, page, or speculative event model changes.
required_scope_for_future_reactivation: Approve a backend STOMP SUBSCRIBE authorization contract.
Enforce role, tenant, session, and assignment at the broker boundary.
Provide runnable gateway/IAM/scheduling/proctor services and fixtures.
Demonstrate authorized event delivery and unauthorized subscription denial.
